meta_title: Lexi — a free app for remembering words and phrases
meta_description: Flashcards, voice pronunciation checks and ready-made courses. Lexi is a free memory trainer for the words and phrases that keep slipping away — no subscriptions, no ads.
hero_lead: Lexi is a free memory trainer for language learners: flashcards, voice-checked pronunciation and ready-made courses that keep tricky words and phrases in your head.
alt_tasks: Lexi task list with correct and incorrect answer counters
alt_task_text: Task text with a translation tab
alt_card: Flashcard with a word and a microphone button
alt_progress: Progress screen with XP, levels and coins
courses_title: Ready-made courses, or your own programme
courses_lead: Start with a course from the catalog — by level and language — or build your own: lessons, tasks and cards take a couple of minutes in the app.
courses_card_levels_text: Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate and Upper-Intermediate — pick a course and it lands in your list right away.
courses_card_own_text: Shape the course the way you study: lessons, tasks inside them and cards inside tasks.
courses_card_text_text: Paste a text and pick the tricky words — each one becomes a flashcard with a translation.
courses_card_progress_text: XP, levels, coins and quests show how far you have come and what comes next.
tasks_title: One task: from text to test
tasks_lead: Every task follows the same rhythm — read the text, go through the cards, say the words out loud and lock it in with a test.
tasks_step_1_text: A task opens with a text in the language you are learning, translated into your own language in one tap.
tasks_step_2_text: Swipe left when you know it, right to come back later, up to delete. The deck follows your finger.
tasks_step_3_text: Say the word into the microphone — Lexi compares it with the original and forgives small slips.
tasks_step_4_text: No microphone around? Type the answer: capital letters and punctuation do not matter.
tasks_step_5_text: Answer every word correctly, get a green check and move on to the next task.
videos_lead: Four short screencasts: a tour of the app, working with a task, settings and loading a ready-made course.
videos_card_tour_text: A one-minute tour: courses, lessons, tasks and cards.
videos_card_task_text: From the task text to the test, step by step.
videos_card_settings_text: Language, checks, colour themes and data: export, import and reset.
videos_card_course_title: A ready course in a minute
videos_card_course_text: Loading a course from the catalog: level, language — and off you go.
download_lead: The web version runs straight in the browser. The Android app adds more: an offline speech recognition model and system voice-over.
download_web_text: Works on a computer and on a phone, nothing to install.
download_android_text: APK file: offline recognition, system voice-over and the full set of features.
download_android_note: Android may ask you to allow installation from this source.
download_point_local: Your cards stay on your device
footer_tagline: A free trainer for the words and phrases of the language you are learning.
footer_note: Made for people who learn languages.
